data.title: Marask
data.subtitle: Care for textured hair, made in the region
data.author: Marask team

data.title: The category is dominated by imports
data.body: Textured-hair shoppers in the Gulf and North Africa spend 70% of their category budget on imported brands, with a 6-month average product lead time.

data.title: Made locally, formulated for the climate
data.body: Marask ships 12 SKUs, all formulated for humidity, hard water, and sun exposure — and manufactured in a single Riyadh facility.

data.title: Raising $8M Series A
data.body: To expand the SKU line to body care, and to open our first owned retail concept in Riyadh.
